### 2026-10-25 – I have spent quite a while working on this project, its been a long week so I only got to it on friday.

**12h**

I have spent quite a while working on this project, its been a long week so I only got to it on friday.

This is what I have been up to!

![Screenshot From 2026-10-24 14-16-09](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/9fac2c33c0dcccf2ebfbd54d3fbe989625bf92a40299ce77b41d411e3204d396.png)

I went with the smaller ESP32 in order to fit within the allowance for this week since the tutorial said its cheaper.

with less GPIO I needed to cut down on some components as well. going down to only one potentiometer and  only 4 capacitive pads .

![Screenshot From 2026-10-24 17-30-13](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/61a4ab6d812a4b8bc6337f8c6084ecae265b8d349b6e6cbdc546df28216f9c45.png)

![Screenshot From 2026-10-24 17-30-27](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/c0f7e54afa7de7f0e3826902e3b9433bc6af045d20b1bfe8385ee0e1c0c080ba.png)

I have based the rough size of this PCB to my small mouse pad on my desk which I find a little funny.

![Screenshot From 2026-10-24 17-30-02](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/b4e93fe0a64e5f90b1e31ee762148b87772b6d9ff3d65c59229573141552bdda.png)

This is where I made my 4 key pads in the footprint editor. it was a little tricky at first since I hadn't used this tool before but I got it done.

![Screenshot From 2026-10-25 20-15-00](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/550b16e27e019026e2ac44115edb11deb0300591cdae0196ae755d893c369fcc.png)
I did have a small mistake however, the pad numbering is all one's, so I had to go fix that the moment I noticed.

![Screenshot From 2026-10-25 20-57-41](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/a024008089d1e7a60a2dd6434b00e6a023c47f6a11c197438f5c8329b222fe67.png)

I had the pads named wrong from before the PCB stage, you can see I fixed the numbering but its backwards with the name of the pads. the names go from right to left while I wanted the pads to be going from left to right.

I had quite a few mistakes scattered about in this project, so rather than fixing them I decided to start over with the knowledge from the previous attempt.
